QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_32

question.text: Section 5.10 requires a Social Impact Assessment firm's quality control system to address ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Leadership responsibilities for quality within the firm
Maximising partner bonuses based on client-acquisition volume
Acceptance and continuance of engagement relationships and engagement-scope determination

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook pp.128-129 (Section 5.10) lists the firm's quality-control system and policy areas: leadership responsibilities for quality, ethical requirements, acceptance and continuance with scope determination, human resources, engagement performance, and monitoring. Partner-bonus optimisation is not on that list and would risk subordinating quality to commercial incentives. The Trap: A, B, and D are all on the Section 5.10 list. C is a commercial KPI that does not appear in the QC framework - the trap distractor. Note: The EXCEPT answer follows directly from the Section 5.10 list on pp.128-129; the six listed policy areas are the operative set.
